description: Blocks the orchestrator from dispatching a non-trivial subagent in the FOREGROUND — a foreground subagent blocks the main thread until it finishes, defeating orchestration. Allows `subagent_type: "fork"` and `isolation: "remote"` (both background by CC's own Agent tool contract), opencode Task `subagent_type` general/explore (inherently async; no background field), `run_in_background: true` (forward-compat only — CC's current Agent tool schema has no such field), trivial one-liner dispatches, and subagent-made dispatches (agent_id present). Deny-by-default: no self-service bypass (ALLOW_FOREGROUND_SUBAGENT env removed); a would-be BLOCK consults RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENT_GATE with a written justification, which asks Telegram via trusted tg-ctl and allows ONLY on an approval tap (a blank/bare 1 denies). timeout_ms 960000 covers tg-ctl ask's 900s cap plus margin so a hung ask can't race the dispatcher's timeout kill into a silent on_error=open ALLOW; a CC settings entry launching cc_hook_bridge must set timeout >960s. on_error=open: orchestration discipline, not a security boundary.
